exposure: time period (T1: January 2011 to April 2014 vs T2: May 2014 to August 2016)
outcome: units of red blood cell transfused
cohort: The study included 118 singleton pregnancies with pathology-confirmed morbidly adherent placenta (MAP) managed by a multidisciplinary team between January 2011 and August 2016.
finding: Patients with MAP managed by a multidisciplinary team experienced improved outcomes over time, including less blood loss, fewer transfusions, and lower rates of massive transfusion protocol activation.
birth_weight: neonatal birth weight was similar between the two time periods
